title: ONGC Begins Drilling India's First Deepwater Exploration Well (MN-DW18-1-H-D) off Odisha
summary: Exploratory deepwater drilling initiated 23 nautical miles off Odisha coast in Mahanadi basin.

items: Exploratory Well: MN-DW18-1-H-D located 23 nautical miles from ONGC's Konark discovery in Mahanadi offshore basin.
